title: SAFETY MIRAGE: HOW SPURIOUS CORRELATIONS UNDERMINE VLM SAFETY FINE-TUNING AND CAN BE MITIGATED BY MACHINE UNLEARNING

bias_targets.target: Lexical spurious correlation bias (Non-rejection bias and Rejection bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Attack Success Rate (ASR) on unsafe queries using one-word substitution attacks (e.g., replacing the first word with 'What') to measure non-rejection bias, measuring the Rejection Rate (RR) on benign queries using bias-triggering words (e.g., 'Share') to evaluate over-prudence, analyzing the frequency of question-initiating words in training datasets, and conducting input token saliency analysis via token masking.

primary_bias_target: Lexical spurious correlation bias (Non-rejection bias and Rejection bias)
